summary: The sole occurrence is already fully quoted under I Infectum sense 1. It adds neither a sense, a form nor a better context; no duplicate is added.

The repeated influencing speech with b qarʕe du malko falls within existing auf jn. einreden, ohrenblasen. The neighbouring kəmfasəd expresses slander separately, so slander is not imported as another ptpt meaning.
The body-part addressee phrase may merit future constructional comparison, but one already keyed example does not warrant a redundant new idiom listing under the current broad sense.
The glossary explicitly labels mpatpatle/mpatpət as I. The four consonants do not authorize relabelling it Q, and the source token is not a light verb plus noun.

The inherited sound-of-stone sense 2 and its Detransitive box have no new evidence in this input and remain unchanged. The supplied German Der sehe ich is not substituted for the inherited correct Der Scheich.
Is b qarʕe productive addressee coding with this verb, or a fixed construction? The present occurrence alone cannot decide.
